WORKDIR /app

  before_action only: %i[create] do
    authorize!("author", "admin")
  end

    if current_user.admin?
      docs = Document.all.order(created_at: :desc)
    else
      assigned_doc_ids = SignatureRequest.where(signer_id: current_user.id).pluck(:document_id)
      docs = Document.where("user_id = ? OR id IN (?)", current_user.id, assigned_doc_ids.presence || [-1]).order(created_at: :desc)
    end
    render json: docs
  end

  def show
    unless can_view?(@document)
      return render json: { error: "Forbidden" }, status: :forbidden
    end
    render json: @document
  end

  def create
    doc = current_user.documents.build(document_params)
    if doc.save
      render json: doc, status: :created
    else
      render json: { errors: doc.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def update
    unless can_edit?(@document)
      return render json: { error: "Forbidden" }, status: :forbidden
    end
    if @document.update(document_params)
      render json: @document
    else
      render json: { errors: @document.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def destroy
    unless can_edit?(@document)
      return render json: { error: "Forbidden" }, status: :forbidden
    end
    @document.destroy
